# Paul Irving & Twin Sailors

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — presumed Friend of — [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) — imaginary rock people who come ashore to talk with him · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares amusing stories and student compositions from her teaching job. She recounts humorous classroom incidents, answers to her creative prompts, and includes compositions written by her students, notably admiring [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter about his fictional rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> In his letter, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) describes his imaginary rock friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md). He details a magical voyage to the sunset with the oldest [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailors.md) before adding a postscript clarifying that the letter isn't actually true.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046)_
